defmodule MailService.Router do use Plug.Router require Logger plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json, :urlencoded], pass: ["application/json"], json_decoder: Jason plug :match plug :dispatch @pool_name :mail_pool @max_connections 10 def init(opts) do :poolboy.start_link( [{:name, {:local, @pool_name}}, {:worker_module, MailService.Worker}, {:size, @max_connections}, {:max_overflow, 2}], [] ) opts end get "/health" do send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok"})) end get "/dashboard" do conn |> put_resp_content_type("text/html") |> put_security_headers() |> send_resp(200, dashboard_html()) end post "/api/send" do case validate_request(conn.body_params) do {:ok, params} -> result = :poolboy.transaction(@pool_name, fn worker -> GenServer.call(worker, {:send_email, params}) end, 5000) case result do {:ok, message_id} -> conn |> put_resp_content_type("application/json") |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{message_id: message_id})) {:error, reason} -> conn |> put_resp_content_type("application/json") |> send_resp(500, Jason.encode!(%{error: reason})) end {:error, reason} -> conn |> put_resp_content_type("application/json") |> send_resp(400, Jason.encode!(%{error: reason})) end end get "/api/status/:message_id" do conn |> put_resp_content_type("application/json") |> put_security_headers() |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{id: message_id, status: "delivered"})) end post "/api/webhook/configure" do conn |> put_security_headers() |> put_resp_content_type("application/json") |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{configured: true})) end match _ do send_resp(conn, 404, "Not found") end defp put_security_headers(conn) do conn |> put_resp_header("x-content-type-options", "nosniff") |> put_resp_header("x-xss-protection", "1; mode=block") |> put_resp_header("referrer-policy", "strict-origin-when-cross-origin") |> put_resp_header("content-security-policy", build_csp()) |> put_frame_options() end defp put_frame_options(conn) do ancestors = Application.get_env(:mail_service, :allowed_frame_ancestors, []) case ancestors do [] -> put_resp_header(conn, "x-frame-options", "SAMEORIGIN") _list -> put_resp_header(conn, "x-frame-options", "DENY") end end defp build_csp do base_policy = "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'" base_policy <> "; frame-ancestors 'self'" end defp validate_request(%{"to" => to, "subject" => subject, "body" => body}) when is_binary(to) and is_binary(subject) and is_binary(body) do cond do not String.contains?(to, "@") -> {:error, "invalid email"} String.length(subject) > 200 -> {:error, "subject too long"} String.length(body) > 50_000 -> {:error, "body too large"} true -> {:ok, %{to: to, subject: subject, body: body}} end end defp validate_request(_), do: {:error, "missing required fields"} defp dashboard_html do """ Mail Service Dashboard

""" end end defmodule MailService.Worker do use GenServer def start_link(opts) do GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts) end def init(_opts) do {:ok, %{connection: nil, message_count: 0}} end def handle_call({:send_email, params}, _from, state) do conn = ensure_connection(state.connection) case do_send(conn, params) do {:ok, id} -> {:reply, {:ok, id}, %{state | connection: conn, message_count: state.message_count + 1}} {:error, reason} -> {:reply, {:error, reason}, %{state | connection: nil}} end end defp ensure_connection(nil), do: connect_smtp() defp ensure_connection(conn), do: conn defp connect_smtp do host = Application.get_env(:mail_service, :smtp_host, "localhost") port = Application.get_env(:mail_service, :smtp_port, 587) %{host: host, port: port, connected_at: System.monotonic_time()} end defp do_send(_conn, %{to: to, subject: subject, body: _body}) do message_id = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower) Logger.info("Sent email to #{to}: #{subject} [#{message_id}]") {:ok, message_id} end end
